I'm a machine learning engineer focused on what comes after training: getting models into production and keeping them reliable there. At [AIPERIA](https://aiperia.com/en) I lead the demand forecasting domain end to end, from the data and the ML platform to the engineering standards of the team. I also drive agentic AI in our day-to-day development, from an in-house Claude Code plugin to an agent that fixes bugs on its own.

I came to ML through a software engineering apprenticeship, a BEng in Computer Science and an MSc in Artificial Intelligence, with research on learning from data streams along the way.

## Experience

### Senior Machine Learning Engineer · Domain Lead Forecasting

[[AIPERIA](https://aiperia.com/en) · Würzburg · Mar\ 2026 – present]{.meta}

AI-driven demand planning for fresh goods. Technical ownership of the whole forecasting domain.

- Own forecasting end to end: from raw data to the forecasts customers plan with every day.
- Rebuilt the ML platform: experiments, training and deployment now run end to end on Kedro, Apache Airflow, MLflow and AWS SageMaker, shipped with Docker and GitLab CI/CD.
- Designed a configuration framework that generates customer-specific and generic Airflow DAGs from config instead of code. Now used across teams.
- Introduced agentic development at the company: a Claude Code plugin with Jira and Confluence integration, and an agent that picks up bugs from Jira, fixes them in GitLab CI/CD and opens the merge request.
- Set engineering standards for the data science team (up to 7 people): code reviews across the team, onboarding new colleagues to the stack and ways of working.

### Machine Learning Engineer

[[AIPERIA](https://aiperia.com/en) · Würzburg · May\ 2024 – Feb\ 2026]{.meta}

- Built forecasting models and took them to production, from feature engineering and training to evaluation and error analysis (Python, Polars, LightGBM, XGBoost, Optuna, MLflow, AWS SageMaker, S3).
- Improved forecast quality across all customers by about 10% through better features and many small, carefully measured experiments.
- Cut the runtime of data and training pipelines by 30 to 50%, one pipeline at a time: measure first, then optimize.

### Master's Thesis

[[AIPERIA](https://aiperia.com/en) · Würzburg · Aug\ 2023 – Apr\ 2024]{.meta}

Transfer learning for demand forecasting with sparse data in bakery chains, built directly in AIPERIA's product context.

### Founding Software Engineer (alongside studies)

[Circable GmbH · Würzburg · Apr\ 2023 – Jan\ 2024]{.meta}

### Student Research Assistant

[[THWS](https://www.thws.de/en/) · Würzburg · 2021 – 2023]{.meta}

Research on online machine learning on data streams (feature drift, concept drift). Presented the results as first author at IEEE SSCI 2022 in Singapore.

### Working Student, Backend Development

[[Plunet](https://www.plunet.com/en/) · Würzburg · 2019 – 2020]{.meta}

Backend development in Java.
